description: This PHP class 'RoundCommand' is a console command for managing project rounds in the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It handles processing active projects, changing their status based on campaign progress, and optionally executing refunds. It includes command-line options for simulation, targeting specific projects, and predicting project end dates.

classes.name: RoundCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing project rounds, including ending rounds, changing project statuses, and issuing refunds.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that processes projects based on options, updates project statuses, and handles refunds.

methods.name: refundProject
methods.description: Executes a refund process for a specific project by running a subcommand.
